name: ms_28l_retrain_zs
setup: set -e; pip install -q numpy tokenizers matplotlib transformers==4.51.3; mkdir -p _rt; echo  | base64 -d | tar -xz -C _rt; python -m babylm.data.prepare --download; _rt/tools/babylm/eval/setup.sh /opt/babylm; cp _rt/jobs_moonshot_28l_retrain.json _logs/; gsutil -q cp __BUCKET__/code/dev_bpw_twin_ref-0026.py babylm/eval/dev_bpw_twin.py; mkdir -p babylm/moonshot; [ -f babylm/moonshot/__init__.py ] || touch babylm/moonshot/__init__.py; gsutil -q cp __BUCKET__/code/dev_bpw_dump_ref-0034.py babylm/moonshot/dev_bpw_dump.py; if [ -n "${RESTORE_URI:-}" ]; then mkdir -p babylm/runs; gsutil -m -q rsync -r "$RESTORE_URI" babylm/runs; fi
note: 28L retrain (experimenter 05:13Z RETRAIN; critic ref-0199 guards): e5 s0-s5 + e6 s0-s2 at the registered recipe @ref-0170, system torch 2.9.1 solo, keep_checkpoints true; per member HF export + twin + twin dump (--check = DEV-equality guard); official zero-shot on GPU (ruler tools ref-0200) for mixtures p01/p23/p45 and e6 s0-s2. Relaunch after a cut: env RESTORE_URI=<old out>/babylm/runs. Pool moonshot. _rt/ = babylm/gcp/rt28/* plus ruler tools ref-0200 (babylm/eval, data/fetch.py, osf_listing.txt) under _rt/tools, embedded as base64 tar.gz.
